note: The attacker-controlled PNG bytes are stored in the context as the parse buffer.
The size query forces ancillary parsing when the first IDAT has not been discovered yet.
Parsing begins by reading the PNG signature and IHDR bytes from the attacker-controlled buffer.
The parser loops over pre-IDAT chunks, using chunk headers from the input stream.
A crafted ancillary chunk such as cHRM is accepted and its payload is copied into ctx fields, extending the pre-IDAT parse path.
The public size query calls get_ancillary(), which re-enters the pre-IDAT parsing logic before computing output size.
After ancillary parsing, the function uses IHDR-derived dimensions to compute the decoded output size, which is the user-visible trigger for the crash path.
